vibe_rationale: Much-loved all-Indonesian music festival with real scene credibility, but expo-hall scale and a crowded sponsor field lean mass-market.
fit_notes: Broad, all-generations music audience with weak wellness adjacency; a rest-zone or hydration partner could fit across 19 stages. Telkomsel holds the presenting slot and partner contacts are not published, so access is hard. Jakarta-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
